notes: Hand-authored, not derived. Rule: the file that computes the number, not the one that passes it along. nextIssueNumber() in src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts takes max(issues.number) scoped to (orgId, projectId) and adds one — including archived rows on purpose, so a number is never reused — and insertIssue() in the same file writes it. EXCLUDED: src/server/services/issue-service.ts (calls nextIssueNumber and hands the result straight to insertIssue; it decides nothing about the value); src/actions/issues/create-issue.ts and src/components/domain/issue/issue-form.tsx (never see the number); src/types/issue.ts and src/schemas/issue.ts (declare the field, do not allocate it).
